text: Align supervisor choice prompts with mandatory human authorization
description: Correct the declarative supervisor action contract after authority enforcement: remove guidance telling the model to choose durable allow/session permission options, state that choice is an escalation signal that stops automation without emitting terminal input, and update examples to request human review rather than select a key. Keep interactive prompt detection and the fail-closed dispatch policy unchanged. Add prompt regression tests proving generated supervisor guidance no longer recommends permission grants and explicitly describes human authorization. Do not restart the running stack.

reflections.context: The deterministic boundary escalated all terminal choices, but the model-facing state machine still instructed the supervisor to select options and prefer durable permission grants such as Always allow.
reflections.outcome: Reframed choice as a human-authorization request that stops automation and emits no terminal key. Replaced numeric/shortcut examples with human-review, and updated EXPLORING, WORKING, and WRAPPING_UP instructions to forbid autonomous selection and permission grants.
reflections.effectiveness: Full wrapped-agents/common verification passes: 163/163 tests, TypeScript tsc --noEmit, and git diff --check. Regression tests inspect both the declarative contract and a generated supervisor prompt for human-authorization language and absence of durable-allow recommendations. No server was touched.
reflections.lesson: Deterministic enforcement and model-facing affordances must agree. A safe gate paired with an unsafe recommendation creates avoidable escalations and trains the stochastic layer toward prohibited behavior.
reflections.pattern: After tightening a capability boundary, update every declarative action description, state instruction, and example so proposed actions converge on the enforceable contract.

supportingConnections.explanation: Gives the human a visible explanation when the supervisor requests authorization.

status.comment: Supervisor choice contract aligned with mandatory human authorization and internally verified; awaiting explicit user acceptance.

valueRationale: A supervisor should not be instructed to seek permission expansion that its deterministic safety boundary must reject; aligned contracts reduce unsafe proposals and needless automation stops.
